topic: What beam management strategies are needed to mitigate efficiency fluctuations (>3 dB gain variance) across the 57-66 GHz band?
consensus_response: To mitigate efficiency fluctuations, dynamic beamforming optimization and adaptive algorithms are crucial. Techniques like rate-splitting multiple access, digital beamforming with subband processing, and optimized array configuration can reduce inter-beam interference and beam squint effects. Beamforming codebook design and finite-resolution phase shifter management also play key roles.
reference_context: SatCom systems operate in high-frequency bands, requiring optimized beamforming to mitigate interference and efficiency fluctuations.
